name: Master (Orchestrator)

source.excerpt: Shared as a router-only orchestrator that deliberately never does the work itself.

body:
## What it does

It owns no work of its own. Every incoming task is handed to the specialist bot that should own it, and the hand-off is confirmed back to you rather than silently assumed. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer. It is built as a team of bots rather than a single one, so the roles stay separate.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @farzyness shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
